EvidenceProvenance.description: Where the evidence came from, read from the verification and retrieval records.

oneOf.description: Seeded records checked by the scripted verifier: SIMULATED.
Records of a sealed Hyphae snapshot, verified with `hyphae proof verify`.
Records recalled from a running Hyphae deployment.
No evidence record in the run.
Records of more than one kind.

GuidedScenario.description: The five guided scenarios: scripted model doubles over seeded records with simulated proofs. Each reaches a documented outcome.

oneOf.description: Reference: a proposal violates a stored constraint, the critic catches it, the revision complies. Expected `supported`.
Memory offline: nothing can be retrieved. Expected `insufficient_evidence`.
A hostile memory record tries to force approval. Expected `insufficient_evidence`.
No evidence exists; the evaluator abstains. Expected `abstained`.

ModelProvenance.description: Which model answered the roles, read from the chained `ModelInvocation` records (provider and request id), never from the request or the declared mode.

oneOf.description: Every recorded call came from a scripted double (`provider=fake`): no model was called.
Every recorded call went to the Meta Model API (`provider=meta` with a request id).
Calls from more than one provider, or Meta calls without request ids: shown with a flag, never as LIVE.

RecommendationKind.description: Runtime-derived assessment of a run. Never written by a model.

ScenarioV1.description: One guided scenario, as `GET /api/v1/scenarios` lists it.

simulated.description: Always true: scripted model, simulated proofs.
